title: G70 infotainment system impressions
summary: Feedback centers on the G70 infotainment system, with many praising it strongly while a smaller set criticize its usability and many other mentions only note that it could be improved without clear sentiment detail.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the infotainment system is a standout feature that owners love most about the vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the infotainment system as terrible or less user friendly than Lexus systems.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention that the infotainment system could be improved, but the limited examples do not clearly establish a full evaluative stance beyond a desire for change.

limitations: Sampled examples are heavily repetitive, especially among positive comments, which limits detail about specific infotainment features.
Many topic mentions are undetermined, so the available evidence does not fully clarify what changes or improvements reviewers want.
The examples are sentiment-stratified and not a random sample, so they should not be treated as representative of all G70 reviews.
